name: Skein
author: Erin Carter
description: Rows of horizontal glowing tubes undulate across the frame like a hank of ribbon cable, each row on its own sine and its own hue. Charge streams along the cables, alternate rows running opposite ways, over a softly lit ground.

params.label: Row spacing
params.effect: Spacing between cable rows in CSS pixels - a dense stack of fine cables at the minimum, a few broad ribbons at the maximum.

params.label: Tube weight
params.effect: Core thickness of each glowing cable in CSS pixels, from a hairline strand to a fat neon ribbon.

params.label: Flow speed
params.effect: Speed of the charge streaming along the cables; 0 freezes the light as static beads, high sends it racing across.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Strength of the soft halo around each cable; low is a crisp drawn strand, high a luminous bloom.

params.label: Undulation
params.effect: Amplitude of the sine undulation; 0 lays the cables dead straight, high swells them into deep rolling waves.

params.label: Wave speed
params.effect: How fast the undulation travels; 0 freezes the waves mid-roll, high sets the whole ribbon rippling quickly.

params.label: Rotation
params.effect: Spins the whole ribbon about screen centre, in degrees, so the cables run at any angle instead of flat horizontal.

params.label: Scatter
params.effect: Jitters each row off its even spacing, so the cables bunch and gap unevenly instead of lying on a regular grid.

params.label: Depth
params.effect: Spreads the rows in depth - some cables read near, bright and thick, others far, dim and thin - for a layered stack.

params.label: Pattern
params.effect: Re-rolls the per-row hues, depths, jitter and undulation phase for a fresh arrangement of the same ribbon.
